actions.action: Water only when top 2 inches of soil are completely dry (check soil)
Move plant to spot with at least 4 hours of direct sunlight
Use full-spectrum grow light 12 hours a day if indoors
Maintain humidity around 40-50% and keep away from heat sources
Feed lightly every 6-8 weeks with diluted organic fertilizer like fish emulsion or compost tea
Flush soil with clean water every few weeks
If soil too acidic, add garden lime or bone meal/oyster meal
Prune crowded stems to improve airflow
Spray with neem oil solution weekly
Acclimate gradually over a week when moving indoors/outdoors and keep temperature 15-27°C
Move plant to partial shade in hot subtropical summers

verdict.reason: The answer names overwatering as the main cause, the opposite of the confirmed underwatering in fast-drying terracotta, and never suggests watering more or switching to plastic pots; its advice to let soil dry further and use faster-draining mix would likely worsen the drying out.
